My suggestion is to extend the duration of industrial training to more than 15 weeks. Additionally, the research component should be completed before industrial training, allowing students to dedicate their full attention to the industrial training period without the burden of concurrent research work.
In my opinion, prior to industrial exposure, it would also be beneficial to introduce subjects related to industrial ethics, effective collaboration with labourers, and strategies for managing difficult workplace situations. These additions would better prepare students for the practical and interpersonal challenges they are likely to encounter during their industrial placements.

text.14i: Although my current career as a Senior Executive in the corporate sector is not directly related to agriculture, many subjects from my degree have been valuable in my professional development. Subjects such as Agribusiness Management, Accounting, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, English, Information Technology, and Management have been highly relevant to my job. These subjects have helped me strengthen my communication, customer relationship management, analytical thinking, and business skills. While the farming and animal production subjects are less directly applicable to my current role, they provided a strong foundation in problem-solving and practical thinking. Overall, my degree program has contributed positively to my career and has helped me perform effectively in a corporate environment.
text.14ii: My industrial training and research project also helped me develop communication, problem-solving, teamwork, and professional skills that I use in my current job.
text.15: Although I work in the corporate healthcare sector, subjects such as Laboratory Techniques, English, IT, Management, and Agribusiness have been helpful in my career. These subjects gave me more knowledge, confidence, and practical skills to communicate with clients, understand healthcare processes, and perform my job effectively.
text.16b: In my current career, farm and animal-related subjects were less useful because my job is in the corporate healthcare sector. However, these subjects are very valuable for students who work in agriculture or science-related fields. Therefore, I do not consider them outdated, they are simply less relevant to my current career path.
text.17: I think more focus should be given to Spoken English, IT skills, Customer Relationship Management, Business Management, Marketing, and Business Analysis. These subjects are useful for almost every career and help students improve their communication, professional, and analytical skills.
text.22: The final year research project and industrial training program were very useful. To improve them further, I suggest providing more industry exposure, practical training opportunities, and regular guidance from supervisors. This will help students gain better practical experience and prepare for their future careers.
text.24: The teaching methods are good overall. However, I suggest including more practical sessions, laboratory sessions, and interactive learning activities to improve students’ practical knowledge and skills. This will help students gain more hands-on experience.
text.29: The current assessment methods are good, but including more practical and continuous assessments would improve students’ learning experience.
text.32: The workload is manageable and worthwhile, but it is quite heavy. Reducing the workload slightly would give students more time to participate in sports, extracurricular activities, and develop other skills while maintaining a good academic balance.
text.35: Strong academic knowledge, experienced lecturers, and good practical and research opportunities.
